mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) signals strong housing market activity, which correlates with rising consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises by at least 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 5.0%) combined with restrictive monetary policy (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signals an overheating economy, leading to aggressive rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing weakness signals a potential recession, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) consistently correlates with lower discount rates and higher equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it indicates a strengthening labor market that often precedes corporate hiring surges and higher earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized) combined with rising industrial production (INDPRO > 94.0) signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized and INDPRO > 94.0.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a housing market slowdown (HOUST < 600.0), the S&P 500 tends to decline as residential construction weakness signals reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 600.0.
